name: table-year-table-subdivision
description: ILLUSTRATIVE: a table year with a table subdivision, shaped like the Nepal example in ADR-0022. The year starts 2024-07-16, 2025-07-17 and 2026-07-17 (the calendar ends 2027-07-16) come from the research proposal and are unverified; the twelve period starts in each year are invented, on the 13th to 18th of each Gregorian month. year_number 'start' with offset 57 numbers the years 2081, 2082 and 2083. The calendar is defined only between the table's first and last entry, so dates, year numbers, shifts, years, labels and dimension ranges outside it are OUT_OF_RANGE. A table subdivision does not split periods into weeks: weeks count from the fiscal year's first day, 'weeks' is null, the parent of a week is the year, and the weeks of a quarter or period are LEVEL_NOT_NESTED.

source.citation: Independent implementation of the spec in conformance/generators/fiscal_oracle.py, written with Python datetime and no fiscalclock code
